FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQs) for JEE (Main) - 2027 
1 
 
 
 
Sr. 
No. 
Question 
Response 
1. 
What is the website for the 
online application form, and 
what are the helpline number 
and email ID for 
JEE (Main) 2027? 
Website : https://jeemain.nta.nic.in/ 
The Helpline No. 011-40759000, 
011-69227700 
and 
18001804747. E-mail: jeemain@nta.ac.in 
2. 
When will the JEE (Main) 2027 
Examination be conducted? 
The Dates of Examinations are as follows:  
 
Session 1 :  20,21,22,23,24 and 28 January 2027  
Session 2:  2,3,4,5,6 and 7 April 2027 
   
Detailed information is available on page 5 of the 
Information Bulletin JEE (Main) 2027 under ‘Important 
Information and Dates at a Glance’ 
3. 
How can candidates register for 
JEE (Main) 2027? 
The registration process for JEE (Main) 2027 has been 
facilitated through “Meri Pehchaan” a National Single Sign-
On (NSSO) platform of the Ministry of Electronics and 
Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, for 
the convenience of the candidates.  
 
The candidates may register using any one of the following 
documents through the options given below: 
 
(a) Option 1: Indian Nationals (including NRIs holding 
Aadhaar): Candidates who are citizens of India, including 
Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) holding an Indian Passport, 
can register through DigiLocker. 
(b) Option 2 i.e. Foreign Nationals (including OCI 
Cardholders): Candidates who are not citizens of India, 
including Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) Cardholders 
may register for JEE (Main) 2027. 
 
(c) Option 3 i.e. NRIs (Having No Aadhaar): Non-Resident 
Indians (NRIs). 
For further details, candidates are advised to refer to the 
instructions for filling out the online application form under the 
heading “Important Information and Dates at a Glance. 
 
4 
Is 
Digi 
Locker 
e-KYC 
mandatory for filling out the 
JEE (Main) 2027 application 
form? 
Yes. Before registering for JEE (Main) 2027, candidates are 
advised to complete Digi Locker re-KYC to retrieve their latest 
photograph for display on the confirmation page. However, 
NRI/OCI/ Foreign nationals may register using option 2 
(Candidates who are not citizens of India, including Overseas 
Citizen of India (OCI) Cardholders may register for JEE (Main) 
2027 using a valid Non-Indian Passport) and Option 3 (NRIs 
(Having No Aadhaar): Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) holding

valid Indian Passport). 
5 
How can Overseas Citizens of 
India (OCI) candidates register 
for JEE (Main) 2027? 
 
The OCI candidates can register for JEE (Main) 2027 by 
selecting Option 2 (Foreign Nationals (including OCI 
Cardholders): Candidates who are not citizens of India, 
including Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) Cardholders may 
register for JEE (Main) 2027 using a valid Non-Indian 
Passport) and updating the details of their valid Non-Indian 
Passport as identity proof, in accordance with the instructions 
specified in the Information Bulletin of JEE (Main) 2027. 
 
6 
Whether 
the 
Class 
XII 
Registration 
Number/ 
Enrolment 
Number/Roll 
Number is mandatory for 
candidates appearing in the 
Class XII examination during 
the academic session 2026–27 
while filling out the JEE 
(Main) 2027 application form? 
 
No, the Class 12 Registration Number/Enrolment Number 
/Roll Number of the candidate is not mandatorily required. 
Candidates can select in the Application Form "Not Available". 
7 
Whose Aadhaar/PAN/Driving 
License number should be 
entered in Digi Locker while 
filling out the JEE (Main) 2027 
registration form? 
 
While filling out the JEE (Main) 2027 application form, 
candidates are required to provide their own identity details 
such as Aadhaar, PAN, or a Driving License. 
 
 
8. 
What should I do if I am facing 
issues while filling up the JEE 
Main 2027 application form? 
In this regard, please refer to the Public Notices dated 28 
October 2026 and 30 October 2026 respectively, available on 
the 
official 
JEE 
(Main) 
2027 
website 
at 
https://jeemain.nta.nic.in/. In case the issue persists, you may 
write to NTA at jeemain@nta.ac.in for further assistance. 
 
9. 
How can NRI candidates apply 
for JEE Main 2027 who do not 
have Aadhaar card, PAN card 
or APAAR ID? 
 
Non-Resident Indian (NRI) candidates having No Aadhaar and 
holding a valid Indian Passport can apply for JEE(Main) 2027 
using the following option on registration page “Apply through 
the NRI (Having No Aadhaar) option. 
 
10. 
How can I change my present 
or permanent address in the 
JEE Main 2027 application 
form after submission? 
If you are in the process of filling out the Online Application 
Form, you can change your present/ permanent address. 
However, if you have submitted the Online Application Form, 
you may submit a fresh Online Application Form. In this 
regard, please refer to the Public Notices dated 28 October 2026 
and 30 October 2026, available on the official JEE (Main) 2027 
website: https://jeemain.nta.nic.in.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQs) for JEE (Main) - 2027 
3 
 
 
11. 
Can I change the particulars in 
the JEE (Main) 2027 Online 
Application 
Form 
after 
submitting it ? 
In this regard, please refer to the Public Notices dated 28 
October 2026 and 30 October 2026 respectively available on 
the 
official 
JEE 
(Main) 
2027 
website: 
https://jeemain.nta.nic.in.. 
 
12. 
What should I do if I am facing 
issues while registering for 
JEE (Main) 2027 through 
DigiLocker? 
You are advised to retry the registration process through 
DigiLocker using your own login credentials. In this regard, 
please refer to the Public Notices dated 28 October 2026 and 30 
October 2026, available on the official JEE (Main) 2027 
website: https://jeemain.nta.nic.in. 
 
13. 
Do candidates have to fill a 
separate application form for 
each session? 
Yes, candidates have to apply separately for each session. 
Currently, the application is open only for Session 1.  
 
If a candidate has applied for Session 1 and wish to apply for 
Session 2 (April 2027), the candidate can log in and pay the 
examination fee for Session 2 when the application form for 
Session 2 is opened.   
 
If a candidate wish to apply only for Session 2 (April 2027), 
he/she may register later, when the application form for Session 
2 (April 2027) is opened. 
14. 
If a candidate did not apply for 
Session 1, can he or she apply 
for Session 2. 
Yes, candidates who missed filling up the Application Form for 
the January Session, he/she can fill up the Online Application 
Form  for Session-2 (April 2027) when the application form for 
Session-2 is live. 
15. 
Can candidates appear in only 
one session, or do they have to 
appear in both sessions? 
It is the choice of candidates.  A candidate need not appear in 
both Sessions, if he/she so desires. However, if a candidate 
appears in more than one Sessions then his/her best of the JEE 
(Main) - 2027 NTA Scores will be considered for preparation 
of the Merit List/ Ranking. 
 
16. 
Will calculators be allowed 
during the exam? 
No. The use of calculators in any form is not permitted in the 
JEE (Main) examination. 
17. 
Candidates who are giving 
improvement/reappearing 
in 
one or more subjects to 
enhance scores in class 12th 
Examination. In such case 
which option to be chosen 
between passed or 
appearing? 
 
 
  
Option to be chosen is ‘Passed’

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQs) for JEE (Main) - 2027 
4 
 
 
18. 
What 
are 
the 
minimum 
eligibility 
criteria/ 
qualification/ age limit for 
appearing in JEE (Main) 2027? 
For appearing in the JEE (Main) - 2027, there is no age limit 
for the candidates. The candidates who have passed the class 
XII / equivalent Examination in 2025, 2026 or appearing in 
2027 irrespective of their age can appear in JEE (Main) - 2027 
Examination. However, the candidates may be required to 
fulfill the age criteria of the Institute(s) to which they are 
desirous of taking admission. For details, please refer to Chapter 
3 of Information Bulletin of the JEE (Main) 2027 which is 
available on the NTA official website. 
19. 
What will be the pattern of 
Examinations in JEE (Main) 
2027? 
The Candidates are advised to carefully read Paragraph 2.4 of 
Chapter 2 of the Information Bulletin for JEE (Main) 2027, 
available on the NTA official website. 
 
20. 
What is the State Code of 
Eligibility? 
The State code of eligibility means the code of the State from 
where the candidate has passed the Class XII (or Equivalent) 
qualifying Examination by virtue of which the candidate 
becomes eligible to appear in JEE (Main) - 2027.  It is important 
to note that the State code of eligibility does NOT depend upon 
the native place or the place of residence of the candidate. For 
details, please refer to Para 3.4 of the Information Bulletin of 
JEE (Main) 2027 which is available on the NTA official 
Website. 
 
21. 
In the case of Foreign National 
Candidates (OCI), what will be 
the Pin Code in the Address 
Section? 
Such candidates are required to put 111111 in the field of Pin 
Code. 
22. 
Will 
a 
candidate’s 
candidature be affected if there 
is a mismatch in the name 
between 
the 
Class 
10 
Marksheet and the Aadhaar 
Card details? 
No. Candidates are advised to enter their name in the JEE 
(Main) 2027 online application form exactly as recorded on 
their Class X Certificate/Mark Sheet. 
23. 
Is APAAR ID mandatory? 
No. 
24. 
How 
to 
capture 
a 
live 
photograph? 
Candidates are advised to refer Step 2 (Application Form), of 
Page 8 (Follow the Steps given under Step 2 to apply online) 
Under “IMPORTANT INFORMATION AND DATES AT A 
GLANCE”, Page No. 5 of Information Bulletin for JEE (Main) 
2027.

25. 
What is the Eligibility and 
Certificate 
required 
by 
PwD/PwBD candidates ? 
The Candidates are advised to follow the instructions of RPwD 
Act, 2016 and instructions/ guidelines as notified in Ministry 
of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India, Office 
Memorandum No. F. No. 34-02/2015-DD III dated 29 August 
2018 for PwBD and Memorandum No F. No. 29- 6/2019-DD-
III dated 10 August 2022 for PwD. (In this regard also, refer 
Para 4.2 of Information Bulletin of JEE (Main) 2027 available 
on the NTA official website). 
26. 
What is the method of UDID 
Card Verification? 
For PwD/PwBD candidates, the details of the UDID Card as 
uploaded will be verified from UDID portal of the Department 
of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DePwD). Those 
who do not have UDID Card should upload Disability 
Certificate in the proper format and the same may be verified 
by NTA from the issuing authority. For details, please refer to 
Paragraph 3 of the Note under Step 2 of the Application 
Procedure given in Information Bulletin for JEE (Main) 2027. 
 
27. 
How can candidates use a 
Scribe? 
The facility of Scribe/Reader/Lab Assistant should be allowed 
to any person with benchmark disability as defined under 
section 2(r) of the RPwD Act, 2016 and has limitation in writing 
including that of speed if so desired by him/her. 
 
In case of persons with benchmark disabilities in the category of 
blindness, locomotor disability (both arms affected-BA) and 
cerebral palsy, the facility of scribe/reader/lab assistant shall be 
given, if so desired by the person. In case of other category of 
persons with benchmark disabilities, the provision of 
scribe/reader/lab assistant can be allowed on production of a 
certificate to the effect that person concerned has physical 
limitation to write, and scribe is essential to write examination 
on his behalf, from the Chief Medical Officer/Civil 
Surgeon/Medical Superintendent of a Government health care 
institution as per proforma at Annexure – I of Information 
Bulletin of JEE (Main) 2027.  
 
For availing the scribe facility, candidates are advised to read the 
Guidelines provided in the Chapter 4 of the Information Bulletin 
for JEE (Main) 2027. 
28. 
What is the basis for the 
choice of examination cities? 
While filling up the Online Application Form, candidates can 
select maximum four Convenient Cities from Appendix - II as 
their Choice of Cities for the exam Centre in order of their 
priority. Choice of Centre Cities will be limited to the State of 
Permanent Address or State of Present Address only and in 
certain cases, only one option may also be available based on 
the address criteria. In this regard, please refer to Chapter - 5 of 
the Information Bulletin of JEE (Main) 2027, available on the 
NTA official website.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQs) for JEE (Main) - 2027 
6 
 
 
29. 
What are the choices for the 
medium of the question paper 
for the examination? 
 
 
 
The JEE (Main) - 2027 will be conducted in (13) thirteen 
languages i.e. English, Hindi, Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, 
Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu 
and Urdu. For details, please refer to Para 2.2 of Chapter 2 of 
the Information Bulletin of JEE (Main) 2027, available on the 
NTA official website. 
 
30. 
Is it mandatory to Upload the 
Category Certificate? 
No, the Category Certificate is not required to be uploaded in 
the online Application Form of JEE (Main) 2027. Instead, the 
candidate should fill in the following details: 
 
1. Certificate Number. 
2. Date of issue. 
3. Issuing authority. 
In case the Category Certificate is not available and candidate 
has applied for the same, the acknowledgement/ receipt 
Number, date of application and issuing authority details be 
filled in the online application form. Such Candidate would be 
required to provide the certificate at the time of document 
verification during admission. 
31. 
Are candidates required to 
send/submit any document(s) 
including the Confirmation 
Page to NTA through Post/ 
Fax/ By Hand? 
No, the candidates are not required to send/submit any 
document(s) including the Confirmation Page to NTA through 
Post/Fax/WhatsApp/Email/by Hand. 
32. 
How are the date and slot for 
the JEE (Main) 2027 
examination selected? 
The Date, Shift and Slot of the examination are allotted 
randomly by the computer. 
33. 
Can candidates correct or 
change 
their 
particulars, 
including the city of the exam 
centre, 
in 
the 
online 
application form? 
As per the instructions for filling the online application form, 
candidates are required to fill their particulars carefully, and 
NTA is not responsible for any mistakes made by candidates. 
A one-time correction facility for selected fields will be 
provided.  
 
In case a candidate has submitted the form with incorrect 
particulars, he/she can fill up a fresh application form. In this 
regard, please refer to the Public Notices dated 28 October 
2026 and 30 October 2026, available on the official JEE 
(Main) 2027 website: https://jeemain.nta.nic.in/ . 
 
34. 
Can a candidate cancel the 
application 
form 
once 
submitted for JEE (Main) 
2027? 
The online application form, once submitted successfully, 
cannot be cancelled or withdrawn. 
 
In case a candidate has submitted the form with incorrect 
particulars, he/she can fill up a fresh application form. In this 
regard, please refer to the Public Notices dated 28 October 
2026 and 30 October 2026, available on the official JEE 
(Main) 2027 website: https://jeemain.nta.nic.in/ .

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQs) for JEE (Main) - 2027 
7 
 
 
 
35. 
If a candidate does not receive 
an admit card, whom should the 
candidate contact? 
Candidates are advised that Admit Cards will not be sent by 
post. Candidate has to download the Admit Card from the NTA 
official website after a public notice regarding the downloading 
of admit card is displayed. For any assistance, candidates can 
call the NTA Helpline numbers: 011-40759000 or 011-
69227700 
and 
18001804747 
or 
write 
to NTA at: 
jeemain@nta.ac.in 
36. 
Can a candidate change the 
examination City or Centre 
after the allotment? 
The allotted Examination Centre cannot be changed, in any 
case. 
37. 
What do candidates need to 
bring to the exam centre? 
For details, please refer to Chapter 8 (Important Instructions 
for the candidates) of Information Bulletin of JEE (Main) 
2027, available on the NTA official website. 
 
38. 
Can a candidate leave the 
examination centre early if the 
test is finished before 
the allocated time? 
No, candidates are not allowed to leave the examination centre 
before the test concludes. 
39. 
How many question papers 
are there in JEE (Main) 
2027? 
For details, please refer to Para 2.4 of Chapter 2 of the 
Information Bulletin of JEE (Main) 2027, available on the NTA 
official website. 
40. 
Is there negative marking in JEE 
(Main) 2027? 
For details, please refer to Para 2.4 of Chapter 2 of the 
Information Bulletin of JEE (Main) 2027, available on the NTA 
official website. 
41. 
What is the duration of the 
Examination 
for 
those 
candidates who wish to appear 
for both B. Arch as well as B. 
Planning? 
For details, please refer to Para 2.5 of Chapter 2 of the 
Information Bulletin of JEE (Main) 2027, available on the NTA 
official website. 
42. 
What is the duration, timing 
and shift of JEE (Main) 2027? 
Refer to Para 1: ‘Important Dates’ under “IMPORTANT 
INFORMATION AND DATES AT A GLANCE” on page 5 
of the Information Bulletin of JEE (Main) 2027, available on 
the NTA official website, for details regarding the duration, 
shift and timing of the examination.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQs) for JEE (Main) - 2027 
8 
 
 
43. 
Does 
the 
application 
fee 
exclude the service charges of 
the payment gateway? 
Yes, the Application Fee excludes the common service 
charges, which will have to be paid by the candidates. (For more 
details, refer to Para 2: ‘Fee payable for JEE (Main) – 2027 for 
each Session’ under “IMPORTANT INFORMATION AND 
DATES AT A GLANCE” and Appendix - I of Information 
Bulletin of the JEE (Main)2027, available on the NTA official 
website). 
44. 
How can one remit a fee for 
JEE (Main) - 2027? 
Refer to step 3 (Fee Payment) of Page 9 (Follow the steps given 
below 
to 
Apply 
Online), 
under 
“IMPORTANT 
INFORMATION AND DATES AT A GLANCE” and 
Appendix I of Information Bulletin of the JEE (Main) 2027, 
available on the NTA official website. 
45. 
What should a candidate do if 
there is a problem in fee 
remittance due to a failed 
transaction? 
The Confirmation Page can be downloaded only after 
successful payment of the fee. If the Confirmation Page cannot 
be downloaded, candidates are advised to pay the fee again. 
Any duplicate amount paid due to a failed transaction will be 
refunded by NTA after reconciliation of fee (Refer Step 3 of 
Page 9 of the Information Bulletin of JEE (Main) 2027). 
 
46. 
How will the Confirmation 
Page and Score Card be sent to 
candidates? 
Copies of the Confirmation Page and Score Card will be sent to 
the registered email addresses of candidates as well as of the 
parents. 
47. 
Are candidates with disabilities 
of < 40% or > 40% or more 
eligible for a scribe and 
compensatory time during the 
JEE (Main) 2027 examination? 
In case of persons with benchmark disabilities in the category of 
blindness, locomotor disability (both arms affected-BA) and 
cerebral palsy, the facility of scribe/reader/lab assistant shall be 
given, if so desired by the person. In case of other category of 
persons with benchmark disabilities, the provision of 
scribe/reader/lab assistant can be allowed on production of a 
certificate to the effect that person concerned has physical 
limitation to write, and scribe is essential to write examination 
on his behalf, from the Chief Medical Officer/Civil 
Surgeon/Medical Superintendent of a Government health care 
institution as per proforma at Annexure – I of Information 
Bulletin of JEE (Main) 2027.  
 
All the candidates with benchmark disabilities who are eligible 
for availing the facility of scribe in terms of guidelines vide para 
IV of Para 4.2.2 above may be allowed additional time of 
minimum of one hour for Examination of 3 hours duration 
whether they use the facility of scribe or not. For details, please 
refer to Chapter 4 of Information Bulletin of the JEE (Main) 2027 
which is available on the NTA official website. 
48. 
What should I do if my live 
photograph is not accepted or 
there is an issue with my 
photograph while filling out 
the JEE Main 2027 application 
form? 
There is a provision to retake the live photograph multiple 
times. The candidate is also advised to refer to Step 2 on page 
8 of the JEE (Main) 2027 Information Bulletin, available on the 
official website: https://jeemain.nta.nic.in/.
